# Atomic Sync

Atomic Sync is an authenticated control plane for auditable rclone copy and move jobs. It transfers regular files organized as complete directory units, with general hierarchy rules and hierarchy-only media presets. It does not provide loose-file units, bidirectional synchronization, symbolic-link or special-file transfer, guaranteed empty-directory preservation, or filesystem-backup metadata semantics.

- [Project documentation](https://github.com/yuanweize/Atomic-Sync)
